fixes.target: figure-p2: What you need to know as a busy builder
fixes.value: Photo panels in three numbered rows, each pairing a red box with a red cross (wrong way) and a green box with a green tick (right way). Row 1 "Plan your work" shows a paved footpath of cut flags against a block splitter machine on site; row 2 "Stop dust getting into the air" shows a worker in a dust cloud and an unsheltered dusty scene against a worker using a cut-off saw with water and a worker using a tool with on-tool extraction; row 3 "Use the right mask" shows a man wearing a loose, badly fitted disposable mask against the same man wearing it fitted. The page ends with the Working Well Together logo, the Crown copyright note and the HSE guidance notice, with the publication mark CIS78 09/14.
fixes.reason: The image is a photo-based do and don't layout with printed headings 1, 2 and 3, and the described content is visible in the photos and printed text.
fixes.evidence: Printed headings: "1. Plan your work –", "2. Stop dust getting into the air –", "3. Use the right mask –"; red crosses on left photos, green ticks on right photos; "working well together" logo; "Published by the Health and Safety Executive CIS78 09/14".
fixes.by: model check, Sonnet (Claude Code headless, packet)
